t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The outcome of the game is based on luck and intuition. You have to try and respond as quickly as possible to try and get the best possible outcome.

vb_textbox.text: Winning this game is pretty much based around how many high scoring baskets of mushrooms you get right. Your best bet is to go with your gut instincts. Do also try and stay alert, as the repetitive nature of the task could make you freeze and daydream through the short time period of responding; which would make you lose points.
